posts.name: K. Sai Mohan Reddy
posts.cooked:
Good Afternoon Everyone,

I am trying to create a file so that i can run my code on practice OPE questions of System command subject but it’s showing permission denied. Can you please clarify it.

posts.name: Anirudh Natarajan Raja
posts.cooked: You are not supposed to create the script file in the /opt/se2001 directory. You are supposed to do it in your home directory like you did it for the BPTs.
